purpose: Recover the shared Type-0x3E/0x3F player-collision MovementVM response, its direct producer handlers, and the child template supplied by its F5-style spawn records.

targets.name: ACTOR_MOVE_TYPE3E_3F_PLAYER_COLLISION_RESPONSE
targets.terminal: 0x0012167E jumps to 0x0012166A; next packed entry begins at 0x00121684

targets.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_TYPE3E_3F_COLLISION_CHILD
targets.role: Type-0x84 child template supplied by the six F5-style movement records

behavior: Both dispatch handlers convert the response actor to type 0x84 and publish the same movement root at actor field +0x0A.
The movement root queues event 0x29, then emits six spawn/copy records targeting 0x001B7B5C with staged signed placements (+1,0), (+2,0), (+3,0), (+3,-1), (+4,-1), and (+5,-1).
The final movement command loops from 0x0012167E to 0x0012166A, while the exact owned region ends at 0x00121683 before the menu-presentation child entry.
